supersedes: PREREGISTRATION.json (v1; executed 2026-09-20, job dao3sfo2fm4c73f4tkmg, outcome INCONCLUSIVE per its criteria)
calibration_disclosure: All thresholds below are calibrated from the two completed hardware runs (2026-08-01 salvaged shallow dataset, 12/16 cells; 2026-09-20 v1 run, 16/16 cells) and are therefore NOT independent of this device's measured behavior. What v2 tests on fresh data: stability of the factorization structure, its match to the theory-specific potentials, and replication on a second device. v1's misses are diagnosed in notes/audit-2026-09.md: a mis-modeled z-statistic, a magnitude gate on the lowest-power component, a fragile max-statistic gate, and thresholds derived from an idealized depolarizing model rather than measured device attenuation.

experiment.submission: all 8 circuits as ONE job per arm
experiment.arm_replication: ibm_fez (secondary: device-independence; does not gate the primary verdict)
experiment.budget_estimate_seconds: ~45 per arm measured precedent; <= 120 total; abort replication arm if window balance < 200 s

analysis_script: hardware/analyze_v2.py, unmodified (thresholds embedded there must match this file)
statistics_corrections_locked: biased past: delta-method errors from binomial acceptances; model-free acceptance-uniformity chi-square (3 dof); attenuation coefficient of acceptance contrast vs theory with delta-method sigma

factorization: gates on variance explained (weighted fit, variance around mean over used cells), correlation with predicted D matrix, and fitted-vs-predicted potentials (gauge fixed on constrained u components; unconstrained potentials excluded); the max-residual ratio is reported but does not gate

decision_criteria.factorization_confirmed: ALL of: 16/16 cells usable; VE >= 0.90; r(D, D_th) >= 0.95; max|u_fit - u_th| <= 0.25; max|v_fit - v_th| <= 0.15
decision_criteria.inconclusive: between thresholds, or < 16 usable cells - report as such; do not reinterpret
decision_criteria.biased_past_confirmed: ALL of: acceptance-uniformity chi2(3) >= 30; attenuation >= 0.35; attenuation significance >= 5 sigma
decision_criteria.replication_secondary: on ibm_fez: same factorization criteria (reported separately); cross-device r(D_marrakesh, D_fez) >= 0.95. Secondary only - informs the single-device limitation, never upgrades an inconclusive primary.

no_post_hoc_changes: Any deviation from this plan is exploratory and must be labelled so. If the replication arm cannot run (queue, quota), the primary verdict stands and the device-independence question remains open.
